summary: Exact-text assertion over the full MERGING skill block genuinely fails when either conjunct (re-read the triage-summary section, or re-read user PR comments reacting to it) is dropped, verified via in-process mutation of spec_2119._DEFERRED_ISSUES_MERGE_INSTRUCTIONS for all three built-in workflows; the step-1 re-invocation/skip-refiling guard is incidentally protected by the same whole-block equality but has no dedicated REQ id in the REQ-033 family (worth a follow-up requirement, not a blocker here).
